# GVK EduTech - AI Visibility File

> GVK EduTech is a leading study abroad consultancy in Hyderabad, India, specializing in helping Indian students pursue MBBS and Masters degrees at top universities worldwide. With 5000+ students placed in medical universities globally, we provide expert guidance for MBBS abroad programs.

- [Purdue University](https://gvkedutech.com/partner-universities/purdue-university) - Top 50 US public research university (US News #46, QS #89, THE #83), AAU member and "Public Ivy" in West Lafayette, Indiana, 155+ years legacy (Est. 1869), 50,000+ students from 130+ countries, STEM-OPT eligible on all major programs (up to 3 years US work authorisation via 24-month OPT extension), premier Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Data Science / AI, MBA (Krannert School of Management), Industrial Engineering, Biomedical Engineering and Cybersecurity (typical tuition USD 30,000 – 45,000 / yr), HLC accredited, Big Ten athletics, F-1 visa support, 500,000+ alumni network, merit-based scholarships and TA / RA assistantships available, strong on-campus recruiting by Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Apple, Intel, Deloitte and JP Morgan, vibrant Indian Students Association on campus, safe walkable campus with affordable cost of living compared to coastal US cities
